_readme: Copy this file to config.json in the same folder and edit it. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. config.json holds your keys, so it is kept out of git.
_source: Where candles come from: mt5 (the MetaTrader 5 terminal on this PC), twelvedata (free API key), csv (a file an MT5 script keeps writing) or replay (the bundled sample, a demo that is not live).
_symbol: Name used in alerts and in the data file names under live/data.
_timeZone: Times in alerts and in the log. Any IANA zone name, e.g. Asia/Kolkata, Asia/Dubai, Europe/London.
_everyMinutes: Minutes between checks, 5 to 15. Checks start 8 s after each 5-minute mark (10:05:08, 10:10:08 ...), just after the candle closes.
_timeframes: Timeframes to scan, in minutes. The smallest is fetched; the others are built from it.
_port: The dashboard runs at http://localhost:8787 on this PC only.
_historyCandles: Most candles kept in live/data/<SYMBOL>-5m.csv (50,000 five-minute candles is about 8 months). The forecaster learns from this history, so it gets better as it grows.
_mt5: python: the command or full path of python.exe. symbol: the exact name in MT5's Market Watch (XAUUSD, XAUUSD.m, GOLD ...). serverUtcOffsetMinutes: 'auto' measures the broker's server-time offset from live ticks; or a number such as 180 for UTC+3. fallbackOffsetMinutes: used with 'auto' when the market is closed and no offset has been measured yet (often 120 in winter, 180 in summer). terminalPath: the full path of terminal64.exe, only when several MT5 terminals are installed. pythonArgs: extra arguments for Python, usually none.
_twelvedata: apiKey: your free key from twelvedata.com. The free plan allows 800 requests a day and 8 a minute; a check every 5 minutes uses one request (288 a day), and the first start uses up to 4 to load maxCandles of history. Twelve Data has no volume for gold, so the volume check on the displacement candle is skipped.
_csv: path: a candle file that is re-read every check (relative paths start from this folder). tzOffsetMinutes: the file's time zone when its times carry none; MT5 server time is often 120 or 180.
_replay: Demo only. Replays data/sample.js on a virtual clock: start at candle number startIndex or at the date in start (e.g. 2026-09-01); each check reveals stepMinutes more (default everyMinutes). Replay keeps its own files apart from live history.
_alerts: on: 'entry' alerts entries only; 'all' also alerts sweeps, CHoCHs, marked zones and cancelled setups. console: print alerts here, with a beep when bell is true. results: also alert when a trade hits TP or SL. maxAgeMinutes: signals older than this (e.g. after the PC slept) are counted but not sent. telegram: botToken from @BotFather and your chatId; leave empty to skip Telegram.
_engine: Options for the SMC engine, the same as the page's Settings tab (e.g. rr, entryZone, killzones, htfFilter, patterns). spread is in price: 0.25 suits XAUUSD at most brokers; use your broker's typical spread.
_predict: Options for the next-move forecaster (horizons, liqHorizon, stride ...). Usually left empty.
